findings.rationale: Across the city instead of driving does not force rail vehicle; 'took the bus' grammatically and semantically valid.
Tiles after cleaning might be wet, and 'Watch your step' remains coherent.
Not an equivalent process, but prompt without explicit scientific definition may invite another physical process; context narrower than some cases yet lacks explicit KU target cue.
Many online customers compare fees before ordering, even though target plural shoppers is valid.
A hiking trail can lead to a cave hidden in the forest.
Committee reached a decision after discussion is natural.
Museum experts could verify the painting's value, though more naturally appraise it; provenance is another possible object.
Photovoltaic panels is a natural technical replacement.

integration_observations: Main learning-runtime exposes rating/grade and approved overlay display; no proof that standalone response object in prototype is consumed by a scored typed-answer parser.
Release gate checks approval metadata, sense binding and activation, not cloze answer uniqueness.
recommendations: Never interpret exact-match comparator PASS as semantic uniqueness.
Distinguish target-form production tasks from open-context understanding; add explicit target clues or provide selected-choice alternatives.
After CG-QA review, build distractor-resistant items and test with human/independent AI blind alternatives.
Keep existing prototype in isolated non-activated staging.
